sourceClock.officialSchedule: Thursday, generally 4:30 p.m. U.S. Eastern time; holiday shifts possible
sourceClock.sourcePages: official dated Federal Reserve H.4.1 release pages
sourceClock.taiwanDecisionUse: Do not count as strict clean 18:10 receipts without contemporaneous source-attestation/capture.

identityRules: week average and Wednesday level are separate statistics even for the same named balance-sheet component
do not mix week-average TGA with Wednesday RRP or vice versa inside one liquidity proxy
do not infer liquidity direction from one component without preserving other reserve-supplying/draining factors
other deposits held by depository institutions is not silently renamed reserve balances; preserve exact series identity
combined TGA+RRP arithmetic is a diagnostic only, not a complete Federal Reserve liquidity identity
falsification: Two consecutive official releases show opposite directions between week-average and Wednesday snapshots, falsifying any rule that treats the two statistic identities as interchangeable.
maturityDecision: D13-16 remains L2/40 because the pages were captured retrospectively and strict prospective Taiwan decision-time receipts remain absent.
